title: feat(lang operator-overload ②): grow opt-in slice — `-`/`*`/`/`/`%`/`==`/`<`/`[]` wired (default-OFF HEXA_OP_OVERLOAD, byteeq-neutral)
body: Extends the PR #4061 `+`→`__add` slice to the fuller op→method set in self/codegen.hexa, behind the same default-OFF HEXA_OP_OVERLOAD gate. Reference-matched to Rust: arithmetic `-`/`*`/`/`/`%`→`__sub`/`__mul`/`__div`/`__rem` (std::ops::{Sub,Mul,Div,Rem}, library/core/src/ops/arith.rs), comparison `==`/`<`→`__eq`/`__lt` (std::cmp::{PartialEq,PartialOrd}, library/core/src/cmp.rs), and index read `a[i]`→`__index` (std::ops::Index, library/core/src/ops/index.rs; struct receiver only — native int/float arrays keep their proven-read fast path). Each BinOp arm inserts the PR's guard block (`if _op_overload_enabled() { let _ov = _op_overload_emit(_op_overload_method(op), l, r, "<fb>"); if _ov != "" { return _ov } }`) before its verbatim runtime-helper return; `_op_overload_method` extended with `==`→`__eq` / `<`→`__lt`. byteeq-neutral: flag OFF (the default for all release/self-host/byteeq builds) → helper never consulted, each arm emits its ORIGINAL string (hexa_sub/hexa_eq/hexa_index_get/…) → DEFAULT 3-target byteeq byte-identical, gen3≡gen4 fixpoint invariant (compiler source never sets the flag nor declares overload methods). frozen-seed-safe (no new keyword, no new @attr). Deferred: `!=`/`>`/`<=`/`>=` (ordered-cmp), compound-assign, Index write (IndexMut), native-backend parity (the gate for any default-ON graduation). Extends self/test_operator_overload_dispatch.hexa (Vec2 __sub/__mul/__eq/__lt/__index demo) + state/rfc_operator_overload.md + ARCHITECTURE.json[language-surface]. Verification = byteeq 3-target + selfhost-byteeq + faithful-nobaseline + shipping smoke on aiden/summer/Blacksmith CI (mini=git/gh only).

title: fix(release cuda-verify): install cuobjdump toolkit sub-package — #4404 PTX guard died command-not-found, cuda asset missing since v0.553
body: FOLLOW-UP defect of #4404 (measured, release runs 28605028220~28606402407): the new PTX-embed Verify assertion died with `cuobjdump: command not found` — cuobjdump ships in its own toolkit sub-package (cuda-cuobjdump-12-6), NOT in nvcc, and the Jimver install list lacked it → cuda job RED on every release since #4404 → NO -cuda asset uploaded (v0.553~v0.574) → installer silently fell back to the CPU asset on GPU hosts (observed on summer: v0.574.0 install → cuda tarball fetch failed → CPU asset). The fail-loud guard itself worked as designed (refused to pass unverified). FIX: add "cuobjdump" to Jimver sub-packages + harden the Verify resolution (toolkit bin → PATH → find, still fail-loud when genuinely absent). The gencode PTX embed itself compiled clean in CI (job reached Verify with build+dlink+package GREEN).

title: fix(release cuda-asset): embed PTX in runtime_cuda fatbin — sm_80-SASS-only asset silently no-ops on newer GPUs (RTX5070 sm_120)

On sm_120 every kernel launch fails cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice silently (cuda_available()==1, banners fire, device buffers stay zero) -> shipped -cuda asset produces garbage: bytegpt_devres_smoke argmax dev=0, max|delta|=551 (v0.547.0 asset). FIX: add -gencode arch=compute_$SM,code=compute_$SM (PTX embed, driver JIT-forward) to both nvcc calls in stage_resolve_runtime_a + build_cuda_runtime; measured PASS after re-splicing same v0.547.0 source with PTX: argmax 32==32==32, max|delta|=2.5e-06, dev-vs-dev 0.0. GUARD: release.yml cuda Verify step now asserts cuobjdump -lptx lists a .ptx image (fail-loud, regression cannot ship). Convergence entry RELEASE-CUDA-ASSET-SASS-ONLY-NO-PTX added (sibling of BUILD-CUDA-RUNTIME-CUDA-HOME-SM80-ZEROS #4216). Item-11 disposition: transpiler hexa_cc.c seed staleness ALREADY RESOLVED by HEXA_SEED_CONVERGE=1 ship path (v0.540.1+ hexat carries forge_dispatch_layernorm/read_f32_at mappings, verified by strings + summer consumer smoke); the REAL residual ship-blocker was this SASS-only cuda asset.
